title: How to Cancel GitHub Copilot and Return to Copilot Free (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel a personal GitHub Copilot plan in Billing and licensing. Access continues to the billing-cycle end, then changes to Copilot Free.
intro: A personal Copilot Pro, Pro+, or Max plan is cancelled from GitHub billing settings. The paid features remain available until the billing cycle ends, then GitHub moves the account to Copilot Free.

steps.title: Confirm that the plan is personal
steps.text: Open GitHub Settings and check whether Copilot is billed to your personal account or supplied by an organization or enterprise.
steps.tip: An organization-provided seat cannot be cancelled from personal billing. Ask the organization owner to remove the seat if that is the charge you need to stop.

steps.title: Open Billing and licensing
steps.text: In Settings, open Billing and licensing. Choose Licensing on the new billing platform or Plans and usage on the original platform, then find the GitHub Copilot section.
steps.tip: GitHub currently documents both billing interfaces because accounts can be on different versions.

image.alt: GitHub Docs showing the Billing and licensing routes for a personal Copilot plan
image.caption: GitHub documents both Licensing on the new billing platform and Plans and usage on the original platform.

steps.title: Cancel the paid plan
steps.text: Open Manage subscription and select Cancel subscription. Confirm the cancellation for the Copilot Pro, Pro+, or Max plan shown in the dialog.
steps.tip: A downgrade to another paid level is a different action. Choose Cancel subscription if the goal is to stop the paid plan entirely.

image.alt: GitHub Docs showing the steps to cancel Copilot Pro, Pro Plus, or Max
image.caption: GitHub's current cancellation section shows Manage subscription, Cancel subscription, and the final plan confirmation.

steps.title: Check the effective date
steps.text: Save the billing-cycle end date and the cancellation confirmation. Paid access remains until that date, after which the account is downgraded to Copilot Free.
steps.tip: If you enabled paid usage beyond the plan allowance, review the usage budget in billing settings as a separate check.

warnings: GitHub says cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle and does not refund unused time.
Organization and enterprise seats are managed by the account owner, not through a personal Copilot subscription.
Verified students can use Copilot Student. Verified teachers and maintainers of popular open-source projects may qualify for free Copilot access.
Copilot Free has limits. Check the current plan page before assuming it covers the same models or usage as a paid plan.

faqs.q: Does GitHub Copilot stop immediately after cancellation?
faqs.a: No. GitHub says the paid features remain available until the current billing cycle ends. The account then moves to Copilot Free.

faqs.q: Will GitHub refund unused Copilot time?
faqs.a: GitHub's current license-change policy says no refund is issued for unused time after a cancellation or downgrade.

faqs.q: Why is there no cancel button in my personal account?
faqs.a: The seat may belong to an organization or enterprise, or the account may have free access as an eligible student, teacher, or open-source maintainer. Those plans are not cancelled like a personal paid subscription.

faqs.q: Can I keep using Copilot after cancelling Pro?
faqs.a: GitHub automatically downgrades a cancelled personal paid plan to Copilot Free at the end of the billing cycle. Free has lower allowances and a more limited plan than the paid tiers.

refund.details: GitHub's current policy does not issue a refund for unused time when a Copilot plan is cancelled. Paid access continues through the billing-cycle end. Local consumer law may provide additional rights.

policyImages.alt: GitHub Docs personal-account policy stating no refund for unused Copilot time
policyImages.caption: GitHub's license-change policy says personal-plan access remains until the billing-cycle end and unused time is not refunded.

retentionTactics: The Manage subscription menu also shows downgrade choices for eligible plans.
Read the confirmation dialog carefully so a paid downgrade is not mistaken for a full cancellation.
sourceNote: We checked GitHub's current personal Copilot plan and license-change documentation on August 25, 2026. GitHub currently lists two billing interfaces.
